title: Helm probe fields: use hasKey, not `with`, so explicit 0 values render
answers: helm chart probe initialDelaySeconds 0 missing from rendered deployment
why does my zero probe value disappear in the Helm template output
MLflow chart probe timing override of 0 ignored
body:
Symptom: a probe timing field set to 0 (e.g. startupProbe initialDelaySeconds: 0) is missing from the rendered Deployment, so the manifest does not match the value documented in values.yaml and README.
Root cause: charts/templates/_helpers.tpl:mlflow.probe guarded each timing field with `with`, and Go templates treat 0 as empty, so the line is dropped.
Fix pattern: guard each optional probe field with `{{- if hasKey .probe "<field>" }}` instead of `with`, so an explicit 0 is emitted and only an absent key is omitted.
Constraints: apply to any numeric probe field where 0 is a legal value. Kubernetes' default for initialDelaySeconds is also 0, so the bug is harmless for that field today and mostly shows up as a mismatch between output and docs. The CI probe step in .github/workflows/helm.yml asserts the startup initialDelaySeconds: 0 line.
applies: Any new or edited probe field in the MLflow Helm chart templates (charts/templates/_helpers.tpl).
says: Configuring a zero second initial delay on health probes is dropped from deployments.
Deployed container manifests do not reflect explicit zero values set for probe intervals.
Why is my zero delay startup health check setting missing after installation?
Allow setting probe timing parameters to zero without the configuration being ignored.
search: Probe template helpers in charts/templates/_helpers.tpl:mlflow.probe must guard optional numeric probe fields with {{- if hasKey .probe "<field>" }} instead of with. Go templates treat 0 as empty, so with drops explicit 0 values such as startupProbe initialDelaySeconds: 0 and causes deployment manifests to mismatch values.yaml and README documentation. Applies to any new or edited probe field in charts/templates/_helpers.tpl where 0 is legal, with initialDelaySeconds: 0 asserted in .github/workflows/helm.yml.
